## Line 125

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/polynomials.library.plato, line 125](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/polynomials.library.plato#L125).

```plato

    //==
    // # Cubic Hermite basis
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_Hermite_spline
    // Endpoints p0, p1 with outgoing tangent m0 and incoming tangent m1:
    //   H(t) = (2t^3 - 3t^2 + 1)*p0 + (t^3 - 2t^2 + t)*m0
    //        + (-2t^3 + 3t^2)*p1    + (t^3 - t^2)*m1

    // The cubic Hermite segment at t, passing through p0 at t=0 and p1 at t=1.
    Hermite(p0: INumerical, p1: INumerical, m0: INumerical, m1: INumerical, t: Number): INumerical
        => p0 * (2.0 * t.Square * t - 3.0 * t.Square + 1.0)
         + m0 * (t.Square * t - 2.0 * t.Square + t)
         + p1 * (3.0 * t.Square - 2.0 * t.Square * t)
         + m1 * (t.Square * t - t.Square);
```
